newsitem.title: USA: Seagram's MCA Records in restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Seagram's MCA Records in restructuring.

text.p: MCA Records said Thursday it was restructuring, eliminating some positions and creating a few new posts.
The move, which had been planned for several months, will eliminate 23 positions and create 12 new posts, industry sources said.

"While these decisions are always difficult, we believe the changes will strengthen MCA Records, reflecting our vision for the label, enhancing our competitiveness, and securing a foundation for future growth," the label said in a statement.
The move follows recent cost cuttings at Geffen Records, which like MCA is owned by Seagram Co. Ltd..
Geffen cut 20 employees from its 205-staff roster on May 30 to lower costs.
